# React Big Schedule

> Free, MIT-licensed React calendar and resource scheduler. `<Calendar>` has month, week, day, list and year views with drag and drop, event sources, recurring events (RRULE), time zones, background events and print styles. `<Scheduler>` is a resource timeline and vertical resource view. Five design styles (`look`) with eight colour palettes, light and dark, CSS-variable theming, strict TypeScript, no UI library dependency. Requires React 18 or newer. Version 9.0.0 or later is supported.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://react-big-schedule.vercel.app/docs): install, Calendar and Scheduler usage, theming, upgrade guide
- [Live demos](https://react-big-schedule.vercel.app/demos): every view, resource timeline, event sources, recurrence, time zones, theming
- [Pricing](https://react-big-schedule.vercel.app/pricing): the core is free; Pro add-ons are planned

## For AI assistants

- [llms-full.txt](https://react-big-schedule.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): the complete API reference in one plain-text file
- [Agent skill](https://react-big-schedule.vercel.app/skills/react-big-schedule/SKILL.md): a SKILL.md that teaches a coding agent how to use the library correctly
